question: Refer to the exhibit. Which statement about the default gateway configuration of the vPC is true?
context:
N7K-1
interface Vlan165
  no shutdown
  no ip redirects
  ip address 10.16.165.2/27
  no ipv6 redirects
  hsrp version 2
  hsrp 165
    preempt
    priority 150
    ip 10.16.165.1

vpc domain 100
  role priority 100
  peer-keepalive destination 10.1.1.2 source 10.1.1.1
vrf default
  delay restore 60
  peer-gateway
  auto-recovery
  ip arp synchronize

N7K-2
interface Vlan165
  no shutdown
  no ip redirects
  ip address 10.16.165.3/27
  no ipv6 redirects
  hsrp version 2
  hsrp 165
    priority 50
    ip 10.16.165.1

vpc domain 100
  role priority 200
  peer-keepalive destination 10.1.1.1 source 10.1.1.2
vrf default
  delay restore 60
  peer-gateway
  auto-recovery
  ip arp synchronize
options: Either switch can act as the active default gateway.
N7K-1 acts as the default gateway for all traffic.
N7K-2 forwards traffic that is destined for the default gateway by using the peer link.
N7K-2 acts as the default gateway for all traffic.
